scientific_integrity: Proof establishes eigenvalue exclusion for all positive epsilon by a strict real-part inequality. Symbolic computation checks Jacobians, the characteristic identity and exact rational examples; finite tests are not substituted for an infinite-parameter proof. Publication priority and external validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Strictly local stability for the deterministic homogeneous six-state equations, with 0<K<1, b1>b2, and all six equilibrium compartments positive. No global attraction, boundary classification, or extensions to delays or alternate feedback are asserted. The excluded degenerate K=0, b1=b2 case can have nonisolated information-coexistence equilibria.
title: Universal local stability of an interior misinformation–SIRS coexistence equilibrium
